title: Sigma Boy
blurb: Sigma boy, sigma boy — the Russian pop earworm that turned 'sigma' from ironic manosphere slang into a playground anthem. The song is genuinely catchy, which made it unstoppable: it charted internationally purely on meme momentum. Play it to summon every child within a hundred metres, or to acknowledge someone displaying certified sigma behaviour.
origin: The viral Russian pop song by Betsy and Maria Yankovskaya that took over TikTok.
